name: NYC taxis and weather
description: How weather changes taxi demand by borough: January 2024 yellow taxi trips, cleaned and enriched, against hourly weather.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: The month the trips belong to

sources.description: NYC TLC yellow taxi trip records
Open-Meteo hourly weather, one point per district

rules.name: known_zones
rules.check: PULocationID NOT IN (264, 265) AND DOLocationID NOT IN (264, 265)

steps.description: Each trip's pickup borough and zone
Duration, pickup hour, speed and card tip rate

columns.name: card_tip_rate
columns.expr: CASE WHEN payment_type = 1 AND fare_amount > 0 THEN tip_amount / fare_amount END

steps.description: Trips, duration, speed, fare and tip rate per pickup zone and hour

dataset.description: Trips per pickup zone and hour

steps.description: Each district's hour, labelled dry, rain, heavy rain or snow

columns.name: condition
columns.expr: CASE WHEN snowfall > 0 THEN 'snow' WHEN precipitation >= 2.5 THEN 'heavy rain' WHEN precipitation > 0 THEN 'rain' ELSE 'dry' END

dataset.description: Hourly weather per district, with a condition

steps.description: Each borough's hour, with its weather
Trips per hour in each condition, against dry hours at the same hour of day
steps.sql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT pu_borough, condition, CAST(strftime('%H', pu_hour) AS INTEGER) AS hour_of_day, trips
  FROM borough_hour_weather WHERE condition IS NOT NULL
), dry AS (
  SELECT pu_borough, hour_of_day, avg(trips) AS dry_trips FROM h WHERE condition = 'dry' GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT h.pu_borough AS borough, h.condition, count(*) AS hours, avg(h.trips) AS trips_per_hour,
  avg(h.trips / d.dry_trips) AS vs_dry
FROM h JOIN dry d ON d.pu_borough = h.pu_borough AND d.hour_of_day = h.hour_of_day
GROUP BY 1, 2

dataset.description: Weather's effect on demand, per borough
